utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard they’re collecting donations and volunteers this week—sounds like it’s picking up nicely. I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if anything specific comes up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess — that’d be a big help. Just let folks know to bring small broken items, and I’ll keep the volunteer list updated.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do — I’ll spread the word about small broken items and keep an ear out for any updates on the volunteer list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right — the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or fix?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Bring any small broken items you’d like fixed, and the volunteers will help out. Saturday at 9 works great too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll bring a couple small broken things on Saturday at 9.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Kira. I’ve heard the repair drive is picking up nicely, and I’ll keep an ear out for any new updates while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oh, is it really getting help already? What’s still left to do?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Mostly just a few small fixes now — the loose gate still needs patching, and we’re waiting on screws and basic tools. I’ll let you know if I hear anything else while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday at 9 works for me—what time are you thinking for the repair drive? Do you know what items they’re collecting?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Saturday at 9 works for me too. I can bring screws and basic tools, and help patch the gate if needed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That sounds perfect—screws and basic tools will be really helpful. I’ll keep it at Saturday at 9 and let you know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring my drill and a couple of screwdrivers and be there around 10.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Sam — around 10 works. If you can, just make sure the tools are labeled when you arrive so we can keep the drop-off organized.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Will do — I’ll label my drill and screwdrivers when I get there around 10.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’ll keep an ear out too and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep spreading the repair drive plans around too. You just take it easy today.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik. I will — and if I hear any updates on the repair drive, I’ll pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Eli, sorry I’m late again — I can still help with the repair drive. Just point me to whatever’s still needed and I’ll jump in where I can.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Dane — let’s meet there at 2:00 PM, and I’ll point you to whatever still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect — I’ll be there at 2:00 and help out wherever you need me.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds like a good mix — I’ve got the hammer, screwdrivers, pliers, and tape measure ready to drop off this afternoon. If you need any extra tools for those small fixes, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus — that sounds really helpful. I’ll keep passing along the word, and I’ll let you know if I hear anyone needs anything else.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, Nell — happy to help out. Just send me a note if anything else comes up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah—what date does the repair drive start, and who’s organizing it?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Hana — I’m a bit all over the place today, so I may be forgetting details. I know Vik was passing the repair drive plans along, but I don’t have the date or organizer straight right now.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: No worries, Noah — if you find the flyer or hear back from Vik, could you let me know the date and organizer? Then I can plan what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn — if you know what’s already covered, I can update my list and see what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sure — I’ve mostly heard donations are in good shape, and they’re just filling a few last volunteer spots. I’ll let you know if I hear of any gaps.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll note donations are mostly covered and keep an eye out for those volunteer gaps.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is getting started. If you need a hand, I can probably help a little.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rey — it’s at the community center parking lot at 2:00 PM. If anything changes, I’ll keep track and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Opal. I’ll swing by the community center parking lot at 2:00 and help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I’ll need to keep it simple today.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s plenty, Uli—thank you. Just come by Sunday at the community center and help with anything simple that feels manageable.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll come by Sunday and help with something simple.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, please send the exact time and drop-off location when you have them—I’d rather not guess. Once I’ve got that, I can pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll send the exact time and drop-off spot as soon as I have them. For now, just let people know to bring small broken items and I’ll keep the list updated.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Got it — I’ll tell folks to bring small broken items for now, and I’ll wait for your exact time and drop-off spot before I share anything else.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is getting started. If you need a hand, I can probably help a little.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Rey — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive plans. You just take it easy today.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Vik. Just let me know if there’s anything small I can still help with.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules. Before I go, could you tell me when the repair drive starts and what items or tools they’re collecting?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It starts Saturday at 9. Folks should bring any small broken items they want fixed, and we’ll have volunteers there to help out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — do you know who’s organizing it, and whether there’s anything specific we should bring besides the broken items?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard they’re collecting donations and volunteers this week, and it sounds like it’s picking up nicely. I’ll keep an ear out if anything changes or if I hear what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — just let me know if you hear what they still need or when to show up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear what they still need or when to show up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. What time later this afternoon can you drop them off?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can swing by around 4:30 this afternoon with the tools.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: 4:30 works for me—thanks, Gus. And do you know if they’re still collecting hammers, screwdrivers, pliers, and tape measures?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — could you help spread the word that the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center? I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll spread the word that it’s Sunday at the community center. Is the start time still 2:00 PM?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, 2:00 PM is still right — thank you, Opal.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. I can spare a bit of time, just nothing too heavy.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Uli — that helps a lot. Just keep it light, and I’ll fill you in if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright, just let me know the basics and I’ll do what I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send over the details and timing right away. Want me to pass your name along too?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, please pass my name along. I’ll keep an ear out for any updates while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Will do — I’ll pass your name along and let you know as soon as I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Oren. I appreciate it — I’ll be there around 10 with my drill and a couple screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, Sam — 10 sounds good. I’ll pass that along if anyone asks, and I’ll keep an ear out for any updates.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Faye — if you know what’s already covered, I’ll keep the list updated from there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m not sure yet, but I can check what’s already covered and get back to you. What items are still needed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still sorting that out, so if you find out what’s already covered, I can fill in the rest.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oh, is it really getting help already? What’s still left to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We still need a few hands for sorting, and the gate patch may need one more look. I’ll bring the screws and tools.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it—can you confirm the exact time and where you want everything dropped off? I’d rather not guess and get it wrong.
